      1 # spelling.yml is blocked per https://github.com/check-spelling/check-spelling/security/advisories/GHSA-g86g-chm8-7r2p
      2 # spelling2.yml is blocked per https://github.com/check-spelling/check-spelling/security/advisories/GHSA-p8r9-69g4-jwqq
      3 
      4 name: Check Spelling
      5 
      6 # Comment management is handled through a secondary job, for details see:
      7 # https://github.com/check-spelling/check-spelling/wiki/Feature%3A-Restricted-Permissions
      8 #
      9 # `jobs.comment-push` runs when a push is made to a repository and the `jobs.spelling` job needs to make a comment
     10 #   (in odd cases, it might actually run just to collapse a comment, but that's fairly rare)
     11 #   it needs `contents: write` in order to add a comment.
     12 #
     13 # `jobs.comment-pr` runs when a pull_request is made to a repository and the `jobs.spelling` job needs to make a comment
     14 #   or collapse a comment (in the case where it had previously made a comment and now no longer needs to show a comment)
     15 #   it needs `pull-requests: write` in order to manipulate those comments.
     16 
     17 # Updating pull request branches is managed via comment handling.
     18 # For details, see: https://github.com/check-spelling/check-spelling/wiki/Feature:-Update-expect-list
     19 #
     20 # These elements work together to make it happen:
     21 #
     22 # `on.issue_comment`
     23 #   This event listens to comments by users asking to update the metadata.
     24 #
     25 # `jobs.update`
     26 #   This job runs in response to an issue_comment and will push a new commit
     27 #   to update the spelling metadata.
     28 #
     29 # `with.experimental_apply_changes_via_bot`
     30 #   Tells the action to support and generate messages that enable it
     31 #   to make a commit to update the spelling metadata.
     32 #
     33 # `with.ssh_key`
     34 #   In order to trigger workflows when the commit is made, you can provide a
     35 #   secret (typically, a write-enabled github deploy key).
     36 #
     37 #   For background, see: https://github.com/check-spelling/check-spelling/wiki/Feature:-Update-with-deploy-key
     38 
     39 # SARIF reporting
     40 #
     41 # Access to SARIF reports is generally restricted (by GitHub) to members of the repository.
     42 #
     43 # Requires enabling `security-events: write`
     44 # and configuring the action with `use_sarif: 1`
     45 #
     46 #   For information on the feature, see: https://github.com/check-spelling/check-spelling/wiki/Feature:-SARIF-output
     47 
     48 # Minimal workflow structure:
     49 #
     50 # on:
     51 #   push:
     52 #     ...
     53 #   pull_request_target:
     54 #     ...
     55 # jobs:
     56 #   # you only want the spelling job, all others should be omitted
     57 #   spelling:
     58 #     # remove `security-events: write` and `use_sarif: 1`
     59 #     # remove `experimental_apply_changes_via_bot: 1`
     60 #     ... otherwise adjust the `with:` as you wish
     61 
     62 on:
     63   push:
     64     branches:
     65       - "**"
     66     tags-ignore:
     67       - "**"
     68   pull_request_target:
     69     branches:
     70       - "**"
     71     types:
     72       - "opened"
     73       - "reopened"
     74       - "synchronize"
     75 
     76 jobs:
     77   spelling:
     78     name: Check Spelling
     79     permissions:
     80       contents: read
     81       pull-requests: read
     82       actions: read
     83     outputs:
     84       followup: ${{ steps.spelling.outputs.followup }}
     85     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
     86     if: ${{ contains(github.event_name, 'pull_request') || github.event_name == 'push' }}
     87     concurrency:
     88       group: spelling-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
     89       # note: If you use only_check_changed_files, you do not want cancel-in-progress
     90       cancel-in-progress: true
     91     steps:
     92       - name: check-spelling
     93         id: spelling
     94         uses: check-spelling/check-spelling@v0.0.24
     95         with:
     96           suppress_push_for_open_pull_request: ${{ github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]' && 1 }}
     97           checkout: true
     98           check_file_names: 1
     99           post_comment: 0
    100           use_magic_file: 1
    101           warnings: bad-regex,binary-file,deprecated-feature,ignored-expect-variant,large-file,limited-references,no-newline-at-eof,noisy-file,non-alpha-in-dictionary,token-is-substring,unexpected-line-ending,whitespace-in-dictionary,minified-file,unsupported-configuration,no-files-to-check,unclosed-block-ignore-begin,unclosed-block-ignore-end
    102           check_extra_dictionaries: ""
    103           dictionary_source_prefixes: >
    104             {
    105             "cspell": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/check-spelling/cspell-dicts/v20241114/dictionaries/"
    106             }
    107           extra_dictionaries: |
    108             cspell:software-terms/softwareTerms.txt
    109             cspell:cpp/stdlib-cpp.txt
    110             cspell:filetypes/filetypes.txt
    111             cspell:cpp/stdlib-c.txt
    112             cspell:php/php.txt
    113             cspell:python/python/python-lib.txt
    114             cspell:dotnet/dotnet.txt
    115             cspell:golang/go.txt
    116             cspell:cpp/compiler-msvc.txt
    117             cspell:dart/dart.txt
    118             cspell:html/html.txt
    119             cspell:powershell/powershell.txt
    120             cspell:aws/aws.txt
    121             cspell:python/common/extra.txt
    122             cspell:node/node.txt
    123             cspell:npm/npm.txt
    124             cspell:fullstack/fullstack.txt
    125             cspell:java/java.txt
    126             cspell:csharp/csharp.txt
    127             cspell:cpp/ecosystem.txt
    128             cspell:typescript/typescript.txt
    129             cspell:cpp/lang-keywords.txt
    130 
    131   comment-pr:
    132     name: Report (PR)
    133     # If you workflow isn't running on pull_request*, you can remove this job
    134     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    135     needs: spelling
    136     permissions:
    137       actions: read
    138       contents: read
    139       pull-requests: write
    140     if: (success() || failure()) && needs.spelling.outputs.followup && contains(github.event_name, 'pull_request')
    141     steps:
    142       - name: comment
    143         uses: check-spelling/check-spelling@v0.0.24
    144         with:
    145           checkout: true
    146           task: ${{ needs.spelling.outputs.followup }}
